title: 归元：小麋鹿·巴西顺拐舞
body: Local SAM 3D Body / MHR, hand refinement, raw and Gaussian-smoothed capture
face: Independent FaceLandmarker; calibrated baseline; gain1; no clip neutralization; blink/lips/jaw unfiltered
camera: Fixed fitted full-body camera; source camera not recovered
limits: Source omits full calves/feet; their 3D motion is inferred and foot floating remains.
Wrist/finger depth, knees/pelvis and subtle expression accuracy remain unverified.
Native mannequin does not reproduce source identity, clothing, pupils, teeth or tongue.

samples.coverage_note: Sampling began after SAM3D completed. Preparation, service startup and body inference peaks are unmeasured; no peak values are invented.

scope_notes: GPU measurements cover the entire RTX3090, including baseline/other processes; not exclusively attributable to this run.
Task RSS/PSS includes this run service, launcher and descendants; sum RSS double-counts shared memory, PSS is preferred.
CPU core percent 100 means one logical core; short phases may fall between 5-second samples.
GPU energy is an estimate from sampled whole-board power over covered intervals, including idle; not whole-system power, total run energy or an electricity bill.
